Compared with the single-component agglomerated particle model, the multi-component agglomerated particle model is more realistic, the general multiparticle Mie-solution theory is used to calculate the optical properties of aerosol agglomerated particle system, which provides a method for the study of scattering problems of cluster structure particles.

articleTitle: Design of A Combination Antenna for Automotive Mobile Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a combination antenna for automotive mobile communication systems is proposed. At first, a multi-band high-gain antenna with a deformed PIFA structure is designed. A gradually varied dish-shaped monopole is adopted to generate a wide bandwidth at high band. To improve the impedance matching, a trapezoidal slot is loaded. The gain of the antenna is improved by optimizing the antenna structure and loading a metal floor. The simulated results show that the -10dB impedance bandwidth can cover the U-band of the walkie-talkie, the 2G/3G/4G communication band, the high band of the WLAN and the V2X band. In addition, a broadband navigation antenna is designed, which adopts a four-port coupling feeding method to achieve a wide impedance bandwidth and axial ratio bandwidth. The proposed navigation antenna can work in GPS, Beidou, Galileo and GLONASS navigation systems. The navigation antenna is loaded above the communication antenna to form a combined antenna, and the proposed antenna is suitable for a high-speed rail communication system.

articleTitle: Compact Dual-band Horizontally Polarized Omnidirectional Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A compact horizontally polarized (HP) omnidirectional antenna with dual-band characteristic is presented in this article. The antenna is composed of a 3D radiation slot for omnidirectional pattern and a folded metal patch for coupling feed. Owing to the offset of the feed patch, the proposed HP omnidirectional antenna has a wide operating band in high frequency. The entire structure of the antenna is completely composed of metal and contains no medium, so the antenna has high efficiency. The antenna volume is 30mm×25mm×10mm (0.24λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>×0.2λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>×0.08λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>, λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the wavelength of corresponding lowest operating frequency). Simulated results show that this antenna has two 10dB return loss operating bandwidth of 5.6% (2.41-2.55 GHz) and 22.6% (4.75-5.96GHz). In addition, the antenna exhibits good omnidirectional characteristics, with gain variation in horizontal plane being less than 2.4 dB among 2.41-2.55 GHz and less than 4.9 dB among 4.75-5.96GHz.

articleTitle: An Efficient Technique for Modeling Metasurface-based Antennas by using the Equivalent Dielectric Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for numerically simulating antennas utilizing metasurfaces (MTSs) and Metamaterials (MTMs). The technique is based on replacing the original MTS or MTM structure by an equivalent dielectric medium with similar electromagnetic characteristics. The proposed approach offers significant advantages, in terms of CPU, time and memory, over conventional methods, and it does so without compromising the accuracy.

articleTitle: Decoupling in Patch Array Antenna by using a Left-handed Material Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A structure based on left-handed material (LHM) for reduction of mutual coupling in patch array antenna is proposed in this paper. The study takes a dual-port-fed binary microstrip array antenna as an example, whose center frequency is 5.05 GHz. And the binary microstrip array antenna consists of two identical rectangular patches with an edge spacing of 0.05*λ 0 (3mm). Mutual coupling in array antenna is reduced by adding a left hand material unit (LHMU) with notch characteristics between the binary microstrip antenna elements. The surface of the rectangular patches is slit to change the length of the current flowing through the path in order that the coupling between the antenna elements is further weakened. Finally, the simulation verified that the isolation between the array elements is lower than -20dB in the 4.1GHz~6GHz frequency band, achieving better isolation.

articleTitle: A Beam-Scanning Leaky Wave Antenna by Using Integrated Substrate Gap Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A novel beam-scanning leaky wave antenna based on integrated substrate gap waveguide (ISGW) is proposed. The proposed integrated substrate gap waveguides leaky wave antenna (ISGW-LWA) can achieve beam scanning from the backward, through broadside and to forward, i.e. from -11.8° to 7.2°. The simulation results of the ISGW-LWA shows that the frequency band with reflect coefficient less than -10dB is from 24 GHz to 30 GHz, which equivalent to relative bandwidth of 22.2%. Furthermore, the proposed maximum gain of the leaky wave antenna is 15.5 dB.

articleTitle: Wideband Antenna System for Multi-Band 8×8 MIMO Operation in the 5G Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this article, a wideband eight-element coupled-loop/-IFA (Inverted-F Antenna) antenna array operating in multi-band of 3100-6500 MHz for 8×8 MIMO (multi-input multi-output) operation in the 5G mobile terminal is presented. The proposed antenna array consists of two symmetric four-antenna arrays disposed, respectively, along two long side-edges of the mobile terminal. The proposed array is expected to be placed on the frame of the mobile terminal. Simulated results show that relative impedance bandwidths of each element and array are all 73% or more for reflection coefficient less than -6 dB (3:1 VSWR) at the center frequency of 4.5 GHz. Besides, desired gain, 3D radiation patterns, total efficiency (more than 58%) are simulated and presented. In addition, good ECC (Envelope Correlation Coefficient) of less than 0.2 for any two antenna elements and acceptable isolation (better than 12 dB in major operating bands) are also obtained.

articleTitle: Modulation scheme estimation using convolutional neural network for multi-beam Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Multi-beam Massive MIMO that applies Constant Modulus Algorithm in digital signal processing with reception of a beam selected from analog multi-beam as input has been proposed. In multi-beam Massive MIMO, adaptive modulation is performed, but it is necessary to share the modulation scheme between transmission and reception in advance, which becomes overhead. In this study, we estimate the modulation scheme of multi-beam Massive MIMO received signal using convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Degree of Polarization Based Homogeneity Parameter for Man-Made Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this work, the degree of polarization information based homogeneity parameter is used for detecting man-made targets. The experimental results for Hakodate area, Japan show that the performance of the proposed parameter is higher for detecting randomly distributed of skew aligned man-made targets in comparison with double bounce reflection contribution and circular-polarization correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: Leveraging Post-Processing Methodologies to Estimate Circular-Polarized Radiation Patterns of Phased Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a post-processing technique, specifically designed for phased array measurements in the far-field anechoic chamber, is investigated to rebuild circular-polarized radiation patterns. The circular-polarized array patterns are reconstructed by two cross-polarized fields from the quad-ridged horn antenna. One advantage of this technique is that the original anechoic chamber setup remains the same, and this method greatly alleviates the efforts of implementing a circularly polarized measurement. The post-processing technique is broadband ready if a broadband receiver is used. In this paper, a thirty-two-element volumetric random-phased array is demonstrated to evaluate the estimated result and benchmarked with another measuring technique of adding a 90° hybrid coupler.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband Reflectarray Antenna Using Machine-Learning-Assisted Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A machine-learning-assisted optimization (MLAO) method is presented to design a broadband reflectarray antenna. First, a Gaussian process regression (GPR) surrogate model is constructed on-line to predict the phase responses of the unit cells with different design parameters. Patch size and frequency are selected as two additional features in the training set to improve the prediction accuracy. Then, the phase range and slope, which are two vital parameters for reflectarray antennas, are mathematically formulated as two objectives and optimized using the evolutionary algorithm (EA) based on the surrogate model. Finally, a reflectarray antenna composed of 576 elements is designed using optimized unit cells. Good radiation pattern is achieved with simulated 1-dB gain bandwidth of 45.5%.

articleTitle: Design of Orthogonally Polarized Yagi antennas for Millimeter Wave Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this work, a dual-polarized antenna system, including modified horizontal and vertical Yagi antennas, is designed at 23 GHz with low profile and high gain. The horizontal Yagi with shifted directors is printed on substrate of Roger RT5880, whereas the vertical Yagi with a U-shaped reflector is embedded in the substrate. The radiation patterns of the two antennas are similar at the endfire direction, and their gains are balanced, providing attractive features for millimeter wave imaging. The gains of the antennas are around 10 dBi and the isolation is above 30 dB across the operating band, though the Yagi antennas are closely located. The proposed dual-polarized antenna system would be utilized for millimeter wave imaging to enhance the resolution of the image.

articleTitle: Design of Slotted Dielectric Patch Antenna with Filtering Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A dielectric patch (DP) with a pair of silver-coated slots is investigated for designing low-profile filtering antenna. The DP resonator consists of a DP with high permittivity and a ground-backed substrate with low permittivity, whose resonant characteristics are theoretically analyzed. For achieving good filtering performance, the silver-coated slots are etched on the DP along the polarization direction, which can not only generate a lower band radiation null directly but also shift high-order TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">111</sub> mode down (close to the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</sub> mode) to build an upper band null since the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">111</sub> mode is non-excitation and nonradiation. For demonstration, a prototype is implemented and tested. The simulated and measured results are given, showing good agreement.

articleTitle: Implementation of C4.5 decision tree in Human Gesture Recognition based on Doppler radars
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of gesture recognition, we investigate the feasibility of using a three-dimensional Doppler-radar array at 24GHz to recognize human gestures with a model consisted of ten classical gestures. On the basis of C4.5 algorithm, phase difference and spectral energy, extracted by correlation processing and power integral, are used as the features to construct decision tree and separate ten gestures. The experiment result shows that this system could achieve a high accuracy of classification reached 99.25%.

articleTitle: A Compact Low-profile Ultra-Wideband Antenna with an AMC Reflector
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A low-profile antenna operating from 690 MHz to 6GHz is studied and simulated in this paper. It consists of a miniaturized monopole and an AMC reflector. The monopole is miniaturized exploiting trimming and folding while a wideband AMC structure is designed to improve its performance at low frequencies. The proposed antenna has a small volume of 25×25×25 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, allowing it to be easily integrated in a compact space. Furthermore, it has a realized gain of 0-8.4 dBi according to simulation, proving that it is suitable for UWB radios.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in the Theory and Experiment of Multipactor Suppression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: The secondary electron emission (SEE) from materials used in high power RF devices in space is the main trigger and sustaining mechanism of the resonant avalanche electron discharge known as the multipactor effect. It limits the attainable power of those devices. Methods of improving breakdown thresholds are key challenges in a RF or microwave device operating under vacuum conditions. In this paper, we investigated the history of multipactor phenomenon briefly and introduced two types of multipactor graphically. Next, we summarize the current main methods of multipactor suppression, and give the advantages and disadvantages of various methods. Finally, we survey current theoretical and experimental research on multipactor suppression by surface treatments. These methods may solve the key issues of high-power RF or microwave devices in space application.

articleTitle: Basic Investigation on a Contactless Slip Ring with Electric Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, the principle and constitution of a contactless SR is presented: A gap between rotating bodies acts as a capacitor and is compensated in resonance with an attached coil. A simplified experimental model was designed and fabricated. According to the current semi-conductor technology, 100 kHz was selected as the operation frequency. The fabricated capacitance and inductance were measured. The deviation of transmission characteristics of the experimental model between measured and theoretical values was 0.4%.

articleTitle: A Wideband Low-profile Hybrid Dielectric Resonator Antenna for 5G Cellular Handsets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A wideband low-profile hybrid dielectric antenna, fitting into a low cost multilayer antenna-in-package (AiP) concept, is proposed for 5G cellular handsets applications. In this design, a planar dielectric sheet with high permittivity and low loss is employed to achieve a low antenna profile and high radiation efficiency. A rectangular metallic strip is introduced for bandwidth enhancement. A 2×4 antenna array is then further presented. Simulated results show that the array has an impedance bandwidth of 17%, a peak gain of 15.7 dBi, a radiation efficiency of higher than 88%, and a low profile of 0.09λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>.

articleTitle: A Luneburg Lens antenna Composed of Gradient Index Metamaterials based on 3D printing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A Ku-band Luneburg lens antenna composed of gradient index metamaterials is presented made by 3D printing. The focusing condition of the lens, requiring a gradient refractive index, is achieved by using the Photonic crystal structure. A dielectric column diamond structure is chosen as the Photonic crystal unit cell since its permeability and permittivity can keep constants when the unit cell size is much smaller than the working wavelength. A standard retrieval procedure is used to determine the relationship between the dielectric column radius of the unit cells and the refraction index. Therefore, a new kind of Luneburg lens composed of the diamond structure dielectric column arrays is constructed. Simulation results have shown that the proposed Luneburg lens, which operating in Ku-band, has an excellent focusing ability.

articleTitle: A Novel Waveform for Joint Radar and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a novel waveform is proposed for joint radar and communication systems. In the proposed waveform, communication signals are multiplexed at the side band of a linear frequency modulation (LFM) pulse, based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). Therefore, the proposed waveform can maintain Doppler-tolerance as well as the LFM pulse and is capable of increasing the communication data rate by assigning the communication signals at the side-band sub-carriers. Numerical simulations was carried out to evaluate the probability of detection as a radar, and it has been validated that the proposed waveform is suitable for detecting fast moving targets.

articleTitle: Pyramid MIMO Dielectric Resonator Antenna with Circular Polarization Diversity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a pyramid MIMO dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) with circular polarization diversity is proposed. It consists of two DRA elements with same dielectric resonator (DR) and rectangular slot fed by microstrip line. The proposed pyramid DR with given width to length ratio is easy to obtain circular polarization performance by rotating the DR to the slot. The difference between the two elements is the relative position of DR to the feeding slot. Two ports correspond to different DR to x- axial angles of 45° and 135° resulting in left-handed circular polarization and right-handed circular polarization. For the symmetry of MIMO antenna structure, two ports have the same impedance bandwidth of 4.65 GHz with the isolations between two ports higher than 21.8 dB under no extra method for reducing mutual coupling. In addition, axial ratio bandwidths are 820 MHz and the peak gains attains at 7 dBiC.

articleTitle: Data Driven Parameter Optimization Algorithm for RPM Based 3-D Radar Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Microwave, millimeter wave imaging radar is indefensible sensor for self-driving system because of its applicability even for optically blurred vision, such as in dusty air, thick smog or fog. As a promising radar imaging method, the range points migration (RPM) has been developed, which offers more accurate target shape compared with a general synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery. However, its reconstruction accuracy largely depends on several parameters, which are usually determined in an empirical way. To address with the above problem, this paper introduces the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) for the RPM algorithm, where the parameter is automatically optimized by the expectation maximization (EM) algorithm. Furthermore, the large aperture data are appropriately processed without significant increase of computational cost, by introducing the iterative RPM processing and new weight function. The results from finite difference time domain (FDTD) based numerical test, introducing a realistic automobile model, verify that our proposed method achieves an automatic parameter optimization feature in data integration scheme.

articleTitle: High Efficiency and Wideband True-Time-Delay Transmitarray Antenna Based on Coding Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this work, we present a high aperture efficiency wideband True-Time-Delay transmitarray antenna based on coding metasurface. For wideband aperture coupling antenna, the True-Time-Delay(TTD) compensation method can obtain better performance than the phase compensation method, including gain, aperture efficiency and side lobe, etc. In this work, ten time-delay units with discrete time-delay values are designed based on coding metasurface. Simulation results show that the transmission array antenna has 41.3% 3-dB gain bandwidth (25 GHz~38 GHz), and the aperture efficiency is higher than 40% at 23 GHz~37 GHz.

articleTitle: Two-ray multipath propagation of MIMO-based OAM radio communications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) has attracted considerable attention as a novel solution for wireless communications for orthogonal eigenmodes. However, most researches focus on line-of-sight (LOS) scenario. In practice, multipath effects are inevitable in wireless communication. Hence, this paper investigates and analyses the multipath effects in OAM-multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication system. Numerical results show that multipath effect brings distorted rotating phase-front and results in intra-channel crosstalk, while multipath effects increase as the diverging of the OAM-carrying wave in higher OAM eigenmodes.

articleTitle: A New Wide Angle Scanning Liquid Crystal Leaky Wave Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: The necessary components to reduce the wide Angle beam scanning antenna, leaky wave antenna scanning Angle at the same time maximize the cycle, reduce the cost of materials, this paper find a new kind of liquid crystal materials, application on the design of liquid crystal planar periodic leaky wave antenna. The antenna is composed of multilayer medium, by adjusting a series of parameters to improve antenna matching and deflection Angle of the beam, the design parameters of the antenna are also given in this paper, by using HFSS electromagnetic simulation computation, the optimal structure of the antenna is determined finally. The simulation results show that the antenna reached - 90 °, 90 ° deflection of the beam,The gain is higher than 8dB. Finally, wide Angle scanning of beam is realized.

articleTitle: A Compact Broadband Radiating Element Based on Microstrip-Slot Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A compact broadband radiating element is presented and analyzed in this paper. This structure has similar performance compared to the previous work[1], including a passband from 5GHz-16GHz, an efficiency of 23.45% at 8GHz, and similar radiation patterns. The advantage is that the presented structure has a length reduction of 32.4% compared to previous design, which made it more appealing for compact applications. The lattice equivalent circuit topology for this structure is also provided, which could be a useful guidance when modifying this structure for different applications.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting Rectenna Applying the theory of Yagi-Uda Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Energy harvesting that converts electromagnetic waves for wireless communication such as LTE and WiFi into energy using wireless power transmission (WPT) technology is expected as an IoT power supplies. However, since radio waves existing in the air are weak, it is difficult to obtain energy that can turn on the LED at a distance from the wave source. On the other hand, in the Yagi-Uda antenna, since the parasitic element acts as a director, current can flow also to the element separated from the feed element. So, in this research, we applied the theory of Yagi-Uda antenna to wireless power transmission and examined to realize energy harvesting. As a result, by constructing a linear array antenna with half-wave length dipoles, the array element works as a director and radio waves propagate. Using the array antenna, LED lights at a longer distance than in the case of one conventional dipole. Through experiments and analysis using kQ products, it has been clarified that lighting can be performed, and further the distance can be increased by increasing the number of elements with which the LED is turned on.

articleTitle: A simple pattern-reconfigurable antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A simple front-to-back pattern reconfigurable antenna is presented. The reconfigurable antenna consists of a square loop monopole with two strips. By switching on/off the two strips, a front-to-back pattern reconfiguration is obtained. Two parasitic patches are introduced to improve the front-to-back ratio (F/B). It is shown by simulation and experiment that the pattern reconfigurable antenna achieves an impedance bandwidth of ~25% (2.1–2.65 GHz) with a F/B of higher than 10 dB. The antenna gain is about 4.5 dBi. The reconfigurable antenna features a simple planar configuration, suitable to be used for wireless/space communications.

articleTitle: Broadband Circularly-Polarized Metasurface-Based Array Antenna with Ultra-wideband Low-RCS Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A novel broadband circular-polarized array antenna with ultra-wideband low radar cross section (RCS) is proposed. The array is made up of 2 × 2 identically circular-polarized sub-arrays in a chessboard configuration. Further, each sub-array consists of 2 × 2 tightly-coupled metasurface-based elements with linear polarization. For radiation, each element is excited and fed with 90°phase shift between adjacent ones to perform broadband circular-polarized operation. For scattering, destructive phase difference is created in an ultra-wide band for orthogonally-polarized incidence due to the anisotropic structure. Thus, a considerable ultra-wideband RCS reduction involving in-band and out-of-band is achieved based on energy cancellation. By this means, broadband circular-polarized radiation and ultra-wideband low RCS performance can be achieved in a synthesized design process. The prototype is fabricated and measured. A good agreement between measured and simulated results verifies the validity of our design method.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Microstrip Antenna Array Feed with Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents a ku band circularly polarized microstrip antenna array feed with waveguide. Microstrip antenna is used as radiation unit for its low profile, compact size. Waveguide is used as the main feed network since it has lower transmission loss compared with microstrip feed network. A slot in the waveguide is properly designed to guide signal from waveguide to microstrip lines which excite four microstrip antennas to form circularly polarized radiation. Simulated results show good performances of the designed antenna.

articleTitle: Transmission Efficiency of Small Solenoid in relation to the Solenoid Arrangement for NFC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper numerically investigates the transmission efficiency of magnetic material loaded small solenoids used for near field communication in view of the arrangement of the solenoid. As the results, it is found that the transmission efficiency can be improved by placing the small solenoid beneath the loop wire even the diameter and length of the solenoid are about 1mmφ and 10mm.

articleTitle: In-band RCS Reduction of Microstrip Antenna Using Reflective Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: An integrative design approach of reflective metasurface and microstrip antenna is proposed to reduce the radar cross section (RCS) of microstrip antenna and keep the radiation performance simultaneously. To illustrate this approach, a novel metasurface antenna is presented. The results reveal that the metasurface antenna has the same working band and radiation beams with conventional antenna, meanwhile, the in-band RCS of the metasurface antenna is reduced. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation and Calculation of a Novel Ultra-Wideband Reconfigurable Salt Water Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a novel ultra-wideband reconfigurable salt water antenna working at 5-18 GHz is designed with salt water. Firstly, the benefits of salt water antenna as a special type of water antenna are presented and the calculation method of the the lowest resonance frequency is also proposed. Secondly, the salt water with different conductivity is investigated. The concentration of salt water affects the conductivity, which in turn affects the resonant frequency and partial bandwidth of the salt water antenna. Finally, numerical simulation of this proposed salt water antenna was implemented in FEKO and the operating frequency, partial bandwidth and gain of the antenna are obtained. The simulation results shown that this ultra-wideband reconfigurable salt water antenna shows good performance in aspects such as reconfigurability, transparency and broadband.

articleTitle: Metasurface Antenna with Ultra-wideband RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, two novel Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) structures, based on circular loop patch and substrate, are designed to realize 180° reflection phase difference in a wide frequency band. These two AMCs' reflection phase property is applied to redirect the scattering fields of a radar target to reduce its Radar Cross Section (RCS). This method of RCS reduction can be realized by covering with a chessboard surface composed of two proposed AMC structures, so the RCS reduction in a wide frequency band can be achieved as well. Compared with the same-sized metallic surface, this proposed chessboard surface can reduce RCS drastically from 8GHz to 20GHz under normally incident waves, and the RCS also can be reduced under obliquely incident waves. Meanwhile, this surface also can be used as antenna. By precisely designing feed network, the metasurface antenna can be designed. This antenna also has a low profile. The simulated impedance matching frequency band is from 9.08 to 10.3GHz. Such method gives a method for integrated design of antenna and metasurface, so the RCS reduction can be achieved, at the same time the radiation properties can be maintained.

articleTitle: A Full-SIW Sequential-Rotation Feeding Network Based Ku-Band Wideband Circularly Polarized Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A wideband high-efficiency circularly polarized (CP) antenna array is presented in this paper. With the specially designed broadband CP element and wideband full-SIW sequential rotation (SQR) feeding network, wideband high efficiency CP radiation can be achieved for the proposed array. For the proposed element, wideband CP radiation is obtained by loading an inhomogeneous superstrate in front of an SIW excited log periodic dipole array (LPDA). Then, a 2×2 array is designed based the wideband CP element and a simplified full-SIW SQR network is also introduced. In order to achieve a full-SIW array feeding, a wideband hybrid mode SIW feeding cavity is also proposed. Besides, by exploring the symmetric property of the LPDA dipole element for 180° phase shift, the SQR feeding configuration is further simplified. With the proposed array design method, simple structure as well as excellent array performance such as wideband CP operation, high-efficiency and wide gain bandwidth are achieved at the same time.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Presents the table of contents/splash page of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Research on DOA Technology of Small Aperture Array Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Array signal processing has always been an important research direction in the radar field. A small aperture array refers to an array whose aperture is comparable to the signal wavelength or only a few wavelengths. When taking DOA estimation for the signal, the performance of the estimation result is deteriorated. In this paper,we deeply analyzed the problem in DOA estimation in the background of small aperture array for the constraint of small aperture array. And we studied DOA based on compressed sensing(CS).The comparison of estimation result between traditional algorithms and CS is carried out. Aiming at the shortcomings of signal reconstruction time of CS, we proposes an improved CS algorithm based on the original CS, which greatly shortens the running time of the program. Simulation result shows that DOA estimation based on CS can overcome the adverse effects brought by small aperture array, improve the resolution and estimation accuracy, and has strong adaptability and important application value.

articleTitle: High-Accuracy Planar Near-field to Far Field Transform for Low Side-Lobe Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Planar near-field to far-field transform (NF-FF) by the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) in antenna measurement is often insufficiently accurate, especially for low side-lobe antennas. This paper presents a new highly accurate FFT based on Gaussian Quadrature, and applies it to discretize the double integrals in NF-FF. An example of the low side-lobe antennas show that although the proposed method is slightly slower than the conventional method, it obtains a much more accurate pattern than the latter does.

articleTitle: Quad-band Metalens Based on Single-layer Transmissive Metasurface at Terahertz
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Metasurface has been widely utilized to control arbitrary wavefronts based on phase modulation. To achieve better performance, it is essential to design multi-band metasurface with frequency-dependent behaviors. In this work, a single-layer quad-band geometric meta-atom is proposed. By simply rotating the meta-atom, the total 2π phase coverage at four terahertz frequencies can be achieved independently. A quad-band metalens is designed to focus a circularly polarized incident wave to the same focal length at four frequencies simultaneously.

articleTitle: Broadband Monocone Antenna with Choke Structure of Composite Right/Left-Handed Coaxial Line
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: The composite right/left-handed (CRLH) coaxial line (CL) is applied to the broadband choke structure for monocone antenna. As the choke structure uses the electromagnetic band gap (EBG), leakage current can be suppressed in broadband. The characteristics of the proposed antenna are simulated. Simulated results show that the proposed antenna suppress the leakage current in broadband.

articleTitle: Research on Space Power Combining Efficiency of Time-Domain Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Due to the limited performance of the device itself, the technical space for improving the output power of a single pulse source is very limited. In order to further increase the output of pulse power, it is an effective method to realize space power combining by using multiple small ultra-wide spectrum pulse sources and combining with efficient time-domain radiation antennas. In this paper, the theoretical calculation formula of the combining efficiency is given from the perspective of time domain, and the delay jitter, pulse width and the number of units in array antenna are analyzed based on the method of numerical simulation. The experimental results show that the combining efficiency is greatly affected by delay jitter and pulse width, and the theoretical calculation is in good agreement with the experimental results. The research results are valuable for the design of space power combining system based on array antenna.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transfer System Using Rectangular Waveguide with Cutoff Parallel Plate
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A wireless power transfer (WPT) system using rectangular waveguide with cutoff parallel plate waveguide is proposed. The operating frequency is set to be lower than the cutoff frequency of the parallel plate waveguide (PPW) in order to make the WPT system leakage-free. A rectangular waveguide at the end of a parallel plate waveguide is provided and the operating frequency is set to be higher than the cutoff frequency of the rectangular waveguide in order to extend the coupling length. It is shown numerically that the strong coupling between transmitting antenna and receiving antenna is maintained over a long distance by selecting the operating frequency near to the cutoff frequency of rectangular waveguide with PPW.

articleTitle: Developing Circular-Polarized Beamforming Techniques on Volumetric Random Arrays with Arbitrarily Oriented Array Elements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper proposes a circularly polarized beamforming technique on volumetric random arrays with each antenna aligned deliberately. This technique seeks to advance the capabilities of spatially distributed antenna systems on mobile platforms. Sixteen microstrip patch antennas grouped as the tested array are adopted to investigate the fidelity of the developed beamforming technique. Each array element is distributed randomly and rotated freely to emulate the real mobile environment. Detailed and systematic beamforming procedures are provided and illustrated.

articleTitle: A Slotted Waveguide Sparse Array with Four-Corner-Feed for Near-Field Focusing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents a double-layer four-corner-fed slotted waveguide sparse array antenna designed for the applications of near-field focusing. At the design frequency of 10 GHz, we achieve a good focusing effect at the focal point of 45 mm. Generally, it is difficult to realize the ideal phase distribution in the array antenna especially for short focal distance. The four-corner-feed structure associated with an appropriate waveguide dimension is adopted to realize approximately ideal phase distribution for a focus at 45mm. The residue phase error leads to the distinct degradation in the sidelobe level of the focal plane. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced to further optimize the sidelobes and the focal spot in the focal plane for ideal focusing effect.

articleTitle: A Broadband Dual-Polarized Antenna Operating in 5G Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A broadband dual-polarized antenna, operating over the new released bandwidth of 3.4-5.1 GHz for the 5G wireless communications, is proposed in this paper. A double-ring shaped crossed dipoles is introduced to enhance the wideband performance. Current distributions and parametric study have been provided to understand the operating scheme of the proposed antenna. Simulated results show that the proposed antenna achieves an impedance bandwidth of 42.9% (3.4-5.2 GHz) with VSWR<; 1.5 dB, and the port isolations are greater than 24.5 dB within the bandwidth. Over the operating frequency band, the gains >8 dBi as well as stable radiation patterns are achieved for both polarizations.

articleTitle: An Extension of Probe Calibration Method for SAR Measurement to the kHz Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A wireless power transfer (WPT) technology is expected to be applied to powering electric vehicles in the kHz band. The specific absorption rate or SAR may be used as a metric to ensure the safety of WPT devices. In order to measure the specific absorption rate, it is necessary to calibrate the electric field probe, that is, to relate the received electric field intensity with the output voltage of the probe. In this paper, we theoretically and experimentally verify that the electric-field probe calibration method we developed in the MHz band can be applied to the kHz band as well.

articleTitle: A proposal on propagation environmental control by a virtual massive array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: With the fast spread of wireless communication devices such as smartphones in recent years, mobile communication traffic is rapidly increasing. Therefore, in the fifth- generation (5G) mobile communication systems, massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) using a large number of antennas in the base station is attracting attention. However, in massive MIMO, the problem is that the hardware scale increases as the number of antennas increases. In this paper, we propose a propagation environmental control method that realizes a virtual massive array with a few antennas by utilizing multiple antenna patterns at high speed in one symbol. The basic performance and effectiveness of the proposed method is shown by the simulation.

articleTitle: An Optimization Technique for Deriving Dielectric Characterization of Microwave Substrates
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This work presents a method of deriving material properties based on coplanar waveguide configuration with a very simple structure (straight lines), and this method can quickly determine the substrate dielectric characterization. The widely used FR4 substrate is applied to verify our method. The error of the derived dielectric constant and dielectric loss tangent is as small as 0.45% (4.38 vs 4.4) and 7.5% (0.0185 vs 0.02) at 4-10 GHz range, respectively.

articleTitle: A Real-time Location Method Under Unknown Wall Characteristics in Through-wall Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: To solve the real-time through-wall location problem under unknown wall characteristics, a method based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed in this paper. Through the training process of ELM, the nonlinear and sick relationship between the scattered signals and the target location is established, then the location will be estimated according to the relationship. The number of random hidden neurons, the activation function, and normalization of data in ELM are discussed. Numerical results demonstrate that all these factors have an impact on the accuracy of the location, and the ELM method is suitable for real-time locating under unknown wall characteristics both for noiseless and noisy circumstances.

articleTitle: Analysis of Water Dense Dielectric Patch Antenna utilizing Six Different Waters for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Dielectric dense (DD) antennas for wireless communication applications were designed and compared for two conditions which are by using copper and using six different waters as the patch of antenna, and metallic copper as the reference. The performances for both antennas were compared and analyzed. The proposed antenna employs simple rectangular structure that is fed with inset feeder. Both antennas offer good return loss -10dB between 4.89 GHz to 5.11 GHz, 4.96 GHz to 5.044GHz and 5.83GHz to 5.88GHz which can be used for wireless applications. The results and performance analysis of DD antennas operating at the center frequency of 5 GHz are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Leaky-wave Antenna Based on SubstrateIntegrated Waveguide Space Harmonic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A circularly polarized leaky-wave antenna (LWA) is implemented on the substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) based on space harmonic radiation. The LWA cuts the current in two different directions by opening a cross-shaped slot on the substrate integrated waveguide. It realizes circular polarization and frequency sweeping characteristics by adjusting parameters of the slot. The antenna achieves a sweep range of 36°~13° in the θ direction backward radiation by -1 space harmonic from 15GHz to 17GHz. The gain is basically above 13.5dB. Parameters of the cross-shaped slot on the antenna performance are studied. The antenna is fabricated and the measurement results are agree well with the simulation ones.

articleTitle: Reduction of Influence of Reflected Waves on Measurement of Human Body Shadowing Loss in an Indoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss reduction of influence of reflected waves on measurement of human body shadowing loss in an indoor environment. We use multiple measurements in spatial and frequency domains combined with averaging. We show the improvement of the accuracy through actual measurements.

articleTitle: Integrated Array Antenna with Radome and Low Noise Amplifier Using Series-Peaking with WuRx
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A millimeter-wave (mm-Wave) antenna array with radome and broadband low noise amplifier with WuRx circuit for fifth generation (5G) communications is presented in this paper. According to the transmission model of microwave incident radome, the proposed structure radome and the calculation method of transmission rate were established. The influences of parameters such as structure parameter, material dielectric constant and incidence angle on the transmission rate and the bed quilt of radome structure were simulated. The proposed single-stage of low noise amplifier (LNA) using series-peaking design by 0.18um CMOS processing for low power consumption RF receiver serving. A linear phased array with integrated antenna elements, designed on a Rogers PCB substrate, has been used at vital sign monitoring in health care center.

articleTitle: A Novel Magnetoelectric Tunable Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this papper, a partially magnetized ferrite is combined with a varactor to simulate a magnetoelectrically tunable microwave filter. Significant improvements in the flexibility and tunability of filter design.

articleTitle: A Novel Frequency-Selective Rasorber For Ku-band Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: These In this paper, a new frequency-selective rasorber (FSR) with the performance of high-frequency transmission and low-frequency absorption is proposed. The structure is composed of a band-pass frequency selective surface (FSS), an air layer and a resistance FSS. The design idea of the hexagonal impedance surface in resistance FSS is to block the high-frequency current by placing the resistors at the vertex of the hexagonal and the tortuous short-circuit branch at the center of each side. This will eventually results in a high frequency passband. The band-pass FSS below has similar transmission frequency band under the same transverse size specification. The simulation results show that the combination transmission passband can cover the Ku-band with a 1dB bandwidth of 8.2dB (11-19.2GHz), and its transmission passband is flat and stable without affected by large angle incidence.

articleTitle: Ray-Launching Narrowband Analysis of UAV-to-Ground Propagation in Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) enabled communications are emerging as a promising solution for the next-generation wireless systems, e.g. to extend coverage and capacity of 5G mobile radio networks. In this paper the narrowband properties of air-to-ground propagation in UAV-aided communication systems are investigated by means of fast ray launching simulations carried out in a dense urban reference environment.

articleTitle: Detection of Defective Element by Cross Scanning Near Field Examination for Symmetrical Planar Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents to reduce sampling data and time. The cross scanning along x and y axes decreases sampling points from N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 2N data of planar 2D scanning. The proposed detection algorithm will find defective elements which is demonstrated in simulation.

articleTitle: Cross-Polarization Measuring Method for Linearly-Polarized Antenna Using Two Identical Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A method of cross-polarization measurement using two identical antennas is proposed in this paper. Two identical antennas are applied as both receive and transmitting antenna, and the cross-polarization level is obtained with the transmitted signals where antennas are placed orthogonally and in parallel. Cross-polarization of both the transmitting and receiving antenna is considered in this method, and therefore, the result is accurate and credible. Two antennas with different polarization state are simulated to verify the method. The simulated cross-polarization level of a single antenna shows good consistence with the calculated results, demonstrating the feasibility and practicality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Array Calibration Effect for DOA Estimation of Desired Wave with Interference Canceler and Beamspace MUSIC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper deals with a method which estimates the DOA (Direction-Of-Arrival) of the desired wave after canceling interferences with adaptive arrays. As the DOA estimation algorithm, Beamspace MUSIC is used for uniform circular array. By computer simulation, the performance of calibration methods which are See and Ishiguro methods is discussed for interference rejection and DOA estimation of the desired wave.

articleTitle: A Wideband Linear Polarization Converter Based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband linear polarization converter based on metasurface is designed, which can efficiently convert linear polarization of electromagnetic wave to its orthogonal direction in wideband. The unit cell of the proposed polarization conversion metasurface (PCM) is composed of a dielectric substrate with a PEC ground plane on the bottom. Three pairs of L-shaped metallic patches are placed on the substrate. Simulation results show that the polarization conversion ratio (PCR) at four frequencies is nearly 100%, and the PCM has a bandwidth from 11.8 GHz to 32.1 GHz with the average PCR over 0.9 under normal incident.

articleTitle: A New Satellite Antenna Concept Using Reflectarray Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a new satellite antenna concept involving a Tx and an Rx reflectarray antenna is proposed. Each antenna is composed of multiple horns and a single-layer flat reflectarray. It radiates scanning beams with different radiation directions in the azimuth due to polarization. Each scanning beam has a different radiation direction depending on the frequency and covers an elongated area in elevation. Each user in the service area selects the optimum frequency band, and the polarization is determined by the position of the user. If a 3 dB gain reduction is allowed, half of the frequency band can be used, similar to the conventional multiple-spot beam antenna.

articleTitle: Application of Single-Cut Near-Field Far-Field Transformation to Linear Near-Field Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: An application of a single-cut near-field far-field transformation (NFFFT) technique to a linear near-field (NF) measurement is presented. The transformation technique is recently proposed using a two-dimensional (2D) plane-wave expansion and geometrical approximation about the antenna under test (AUT). It allows the single-cut far-field transformation with high flexibility of positions and orientations of the probe in the measurements. However, it has been applied only to a circular measurement in the previous works. We present here its application to a linear measurement to show the applicability of the technique for flexible measurement situations. The accuracy of the transformation technique is analyzed, and the validity of the method is shown.

articleTitle: Glass Dielectric Resonator Antenna with Inner 3D Engraved Pattern
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a transparent glass dielectric resonator (DR) antenna (DRA) with omnidirectional radiation patterns is designed at 2.4 GHz and demonstrated in a multifunctional Wi-Fi router system. The glass DRA is engraved with an inner 3D pattern to make it more aesthetically pleasing. To obtain the omnidirectional radiation patterns, the glass DRA is excited by a central probe inside. For demonstration, the prototype was fabricated and measured showing results reasonably consistent with the simulated ones. For testing the entire Wi-Fi router system, the glass DRA is placed on the top of a cylindrical lamp base which integrates multi-function modules and makes the antenna rotate. It was found the entire system can work properly as expected. This idea can be extended to include any inner 3D patterns in any forms.

articleTitle: A Metaspiral Antenna for Azimuthal Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A metaspiral antenna is investigated for the capability of steering its circularly polarized beam in the azimuth direction. The feed of this antenna is a combination of a ζ-type feed and an α-type feed that have weighting coefficients Z and A, respectively. The ζ- and α-type feeds generate different phase distributions around the z-axis normal to the antenna plane, creating a radiation beam that is tilted from the z-axis. It is found that, when |Z| = |A|, the beam is steered in the azimuth direction, with the tilt angle remaining constant. The validity of the theoretically derived tilted beam azimuth angle is confirmed by demonstrating good agreement with the angle obtained through numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Design of a Printed Broadband Cross-Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A broadband dual-polarized antenna fed by 50 ohm microstrip line is presented in this letter. The proposed antenna consists of four patches, two short pins and two feed structures. When two patches excite one polarized wave, the other patches are working as a parasitic structure. By the introduce of the short pins as a compensating component, the isolation and the cross polarization of the purposed antenna is improved. The proposed antenna achieves a 35.4% (3.9-5.6 GHz) relative bandwidth is achieved. Normalized cross polarization level is lower than -30 dB and isolation between ports is higher than 27 dB.

articleTitle: Non-orthogonal Pilot Design for Compressive Sensing-Based Channel Estimation in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In recent years, the channel estimation based on compressive sensing (CS), which can reduce pilot overhead in frequency division duplex (FDD) massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems, has inspired the enthusiasm of researchers. This research includes an essential component which is exploring non-orthogonal pilot design. In this paper, we propose a joint pilot positions and power design scheme. In this scheme, the greedy iterative algorithm is introduced to search for the suboptimal pilot subcarriers and the genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed to optimize the pilot power of candidate positions. Lastly, the block orthogonal matching pursuit (BOMP) is introduced to estimate delay-domain sparse channels. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed pilot design scheme outperforms the uniformly-spaced pilot scheme and the randomly-spaced pilot scheme in terms of normalized mean square error (NMSE).

articleTitle: Limitation of available phase mode and excitation phase mode in OAM Circular array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: The common limitation rule of the available orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode of a circular array is proved and validated. And the relationship between the excitation mode and the available mode of the field radiated by a circular array is analyzed. In addition, the purity of different mode is defined and the influence of the array parameters to the purity of each mode is discussed.

articleTitle: Imaging of Unknown Anomaly via Scattering Matrix With and Without Diagonal Elements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A non-iterative imaging of unknown anomaly from scattering matrix whose elements are measured scattering parameters considered herein. We apply Kirchhoff migration when the diagonal elements of scattering matrix are available or unavailable, and examine that one can obtain good result without diagonal elements. Simulation results are presented to show the feasibility and compare the imaging performance.

articleTitle: Holographic Antenna with Slotted Yagi Array Antenna as Surface Wave Launcher
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, the holographic antenna with 4 elements of slotted Yagi array antenna as surface wave launcher is proposed to generate the plane wave holographic pattern within the small size of the antenna. The type of the feeder antenna is chosen to the slotted Yagi antenna for mode which radiates uni-directionally. The main radiator of the feeder antenna is modified to reduce mutual coupling. By arraying 4 elements of the feed antennas, they are able to generate plane wave just in front of themselves. The proposed holographic antenna with 12 metal strips is designed on the substrate of 24.25 × 70 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and analyzed the characteristics of the gain and the radiation efficiency.

articleTitle: A 16-Beam Array Design for Access Points with 3-D Beam Coverage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-beam array antenna design that yields directive beams toward different directions. The four-layer 16-by-16 feeding network provides phase delay profiles for a 4-by-4 antenna array to generate squint beams arranged in an axially symmetric fashion, which is particularly suitable for ceiling-mount or wall-mount access points. Simulation results verify that such a multi-beam array configuration can provide apparent pattern diversity. For a conventional transceiver, RF switches can be employed to facilitate beam scanning in a 3-D space. For a multi-transceiver device, coexisting beams can provide a wide coverage and support massive MIMO.

articleTitle: Wideband Multi-layer Frequency Selective Surface Based Transmitarray Unit Cell for Satellite Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a double square ring with center patch based wideband multilayer frequency selective surface unit cell is designed for transmitarray antenna at 12GHz. The proposed FSS unit cell has high transmittance magnitude and covers the full 360° phase range required for transmitarray design. Effect of increasing the number of FSS layers on transmittance is illustrated using parametric simulations. Combined analysis of multilayer designs over wideband frequency range is carried out. The effect of relative permittivity of substrates is illustrated using FR4 and RT/Duroid 5880. For RT/Duroid based 4-layer FSS unit cell, high transmittance magnitude value above -1dB for 4.7GHz wideband and phase range of 395.6° is achieved. The proposed unit cell will find applications in high gain, wideband transmitarrays for satellite communication applications.

articleTitle: Improvement of Numerical Calculations for Heating Performances of Microwave Therapeutic Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this study, to obtain a more accurate analysis of the temperature in microwave coagulation therapy (MCT) for hepatocellular carcinoma, the water content rations of liver tissue during the heating and the dependencies of the dielectric and thermal constants of the tissue on the water content ratios were investigated in microwave heating at 2.45 GHz. In addition, generally, biological tissue coagulates at approximately 60 °C or higher. Therefore, distributions of temperature elevation have been calculated and analyzed. However, when the heating time is long, the biological tissue coagulates even if it is less than 60 °C. In this study, shape of the coagulated region by a microwave surgical device is calculated.

articleTitle: Two-Antenna Array With T-shaped Neutralization Line for 5G Wideband Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Two-antenna MIMO array with T-shaped neutralization line is presented for 5G wideband application. The antenna element fed by coupling, which is composed of a novel inverted F patch and a meander feedline, has the performance of ultra-wideband (UWB). The T-shaped neutralization line is connected between two symmetrically placed antenna elements to enhance the isolation for the two-antenna array without affecting other performances of the MIMO antenna. The proposed MIMO antenna is fabricated and measured. Compared with the MIMO antenna without neutralization line, the isolation of the proposed MIMO antenna is improved for 4.0-5.95GHz and is better than 20dB. The envelope correlation coefficient of the proposed MIMO antenna is less than 0.01, which is much smaller than 0.5.

articleTitle: A Wearable Filtering Antenna Based on Multilayer Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a novel compact wearable filtering antenna based on multilayer structure is proposed for modern wireless communication systems. Different dielectric materials are selected to satisfy the design requirements. The filtering antenna system consists of two λ/2 hairpin resonators which improve the selectivity of passband and a rectangular patch antenna which also works as the last order resonator of the filter structure. Comparing with antenna structure, a harder and smaller dielectric slab used for filtering network can reduce the performance deterioration caused by the deformation of the textile material where the antenna is located. The simulated results shows that the filter-antenna features 12.2% bandwidth for f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 5.5GHz with peak radiation gain of -5.4dB.

articleTitle: Transmission Error Correction Using Eigenvectors in MIMO Radar with Overlapping Elements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In the MIMO radar using the transmission antenna switching, the phase and amplitude errors in the transmission signals may yield deterioration of the estimation accuracy of target directions. In this paper, we introduce overlapping elements in the virtual array of MIMO radar, and we improve the estimation accuracy by correcting transmission signal errors with the eigenvectors of receive correlation matrix.

articleTitle: Wideband RCS Reduction Based on Dual-Polarization Frequency Selective Rasorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper introduces a kind of frequency selective rasorber. By combining the upper lossy layer and the bottom lossless layer, one passband with two-sided absorption band is obtained. A 4×4 array is constructed to realize radar cross section (RCS) reduction.The 5dB RCS redction bandwidth is from 5GHz to 15GHz(relative bandwidth is 100%). It is also worth pointing out that the maximum RCSR is 29.7dB and 31.2dB around 8.8GHz for x- and y-polarized incident waves.

articleTitle: Dual Polarization 4x4 MIMO Sub-6GHz Multi-Beam Base Station Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of compact dual polarized 4x4 MIMO sub-6GHz multi-beam base station antennas covering frequencies from 3.3 to 3.8 GHz. The 4x4 MIMO multi-beam antennas are realized through stacking two 2x2 MIMO multi-beam antenna arrays vertically. By using different numbers of columns and rows of the antenna array, the several 4x4 MIMO 3-beam and 6-beam antennas are designed and tested. Detailed array architecture and corresponding measured results are presented.

articleTitle: A Study of Impedance Switched Folded Monopole Antenna with Robustness to Metal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In order to achieve an antenna with robustness to metal for closed space wireless communications, the impedance characteristics of folded monopole antennas (FMA) have been investigated in detail. In this study, we propose the folded monopole antenna, which can switch the input impedance and resonant frequency by a simple method. Simulated results show the antenna which can be switched to three modes with different resonant frequencies and input impedance by controlling the connection of the antenna elements.

articleTitle: Modeling of Corroded Reinforcing Bar for Nondestructive Inspection of Concrete Using UWB Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper proposes an analysis model of corroded rebar for nondestructive inspection (NDI) of concrete structures using ultra-wideband (UWB) radar and shows some simulation results. Corrosion is modeled by a rust layer formed by rusting of rebar surface and a transition layer between the rust layer and surrounding healthy concrete. Distribution of complex permittivity in transition layer is determined by solving a diffusion equation of rust particle. UWB radar responses from some different corroded samples are shown as simulation results.

articleTitle: Compact Antenna Using Novel Finger-Connected Interdigital Capacitor-Based Substrate Integrated Waveguide Cavity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: A electrical small antenna using a novel finger-connected interdigital capacitor (FC-IDC), based on composite right/left handed (CRLH) unit cell, is proposed in this paper. The proposed CRLH antenna consists of a thin rectangle substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity with the etched interdigital slot on the top metal surface and two etched slot rings on the bottom metal surface, which is fed by a grounded co-planar waveguide (GCPW). The interdigital slot acts as a series capacitor as well as a radiator leading to a CRLH antenna application. Compared to other conventional CRLH antenna, the proposed one has a lower -1st-order resonant mode. thus, the present design has a smaller electrical size. The results show that the antenna using a novel CRLH-TL unit cell based on FC-IDC achieves 30.5% reductions in operating frequencies compared with the conventional CRLH antennas with the same size. In addition, the novel designed antenna can be easily fabricated by printed circuit board technology, which is of important significance in the miniaturization of communication system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Satellite-ground Frequency Deviation and Compensation Method for LEO Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Due to the shortage of spectrum resource and fierce competition of LEO mobile communication system, improving the efficiency of spectrum resource utilization becomes critical to system design. In LEO mobile communication system, user-segment uplink is the key to the entire system, and the improvement of spectrum resource utilization in user-segment uplink can significantly improve the spectral efficiency of the entire system. Based on the technical characteristics of typical LEO mobile communication systems in the world, this paper analyses the mechanism of frequency deviation between satellite and ground of LEO mobile communication system, and gives the corresponding compensation method for frequency deviation. Our method reduces the protection bandwidth of user-segment uplink, which further improves the efficiency of spectrum resource utilization.

articleTitle: Study of Mutual Coupling Reduction for PIFA MIMO Antenna with Pattern Diversity for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, three different methods of spatial and pattern diversity have been studied to reduce mutual coupling and improve the overall performance of a PIFA MIMO. The proposed antenna consists of parasitic wall elements embedded at the edge of the ground plane with U-slot in the middle of the ground plane is fabricated using copper sheet with thickness of 0.45 mm and air as the dielectric substrates. The performance of the proposed antenna is simulated using CST Microwave Studio Software. The proposed antenna is measured to validate the simulation results. The best isolation of greater than 20 dB were achieved in the both simulated and measured antenna. Thus this proposed PIFA MIMO offers a promising solution for future 5G wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: An Efficient Wideband Analysis Method Based on ASED Basis Function Method and Improved FIR For Large-Scale Finite Periodic Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: An efficient wideband analysis method for the large-scale finite periodic structures is presented by using the accurate sub-entire domain (ASED) basis function method and the improved frequency-independent reaction (FIR). By using the ASED basis function, the number of unknowns can be reduced from QN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> to N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>, where Q is the number of Rao-Wilton-Glisson basis functions defined on each cell and N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> is the number of cells. By using the improved FIR for frequency sweep, the impedance matrix elements can be efficiently computed. In this method, the impedance elements are classified as two categories: near-region ones and far-region ones. The former ones are computed by using the method based on the Taylor series expansion. The latter ones are calculated using the technique based on the equivalent dipole-moment method. Several examples are conducted in order to demonstrate the proposed technique. Simulation results show that good agreement between the results of the proposed technique and the results of the ASED-FIR is achieved. The CPU time can be reduced by almost 40% comparing with the ASED-FIR.

articleTitle: A comb-like dipole array with wide bandwith and scanning properties
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, we present a comb-like connected dipole array with integrated Marchand balun, which contain strip-line, dipole and vertical metal strips. The vertical metal strips located at the edges of the element to connect the dipole and ground, also serve as ground for Marchand. In this way, we can avoid the appearance of any resonant common-mode in the working band. What's more, an even current distributions on the dipoles can be achieved, which will be enhanced to stabilize the performance of array at different scanning angle. the proposed approach provides 4.58:1 bandwidth with VSWR <; 2.2 throughout the entire scanning range of ±60° in E plane without any superstrate.

articleTitle: Design of a non-uniform 8-element array for passive coherent location systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-uniform 8-element array antenna to maximize the beamforming performance of FM based PCL systems. The proposed non-uniform array has two elements groups with different distances from the center to element. Beamforming performances such as PSLR and HPBW are compare with a uniform circular array, and the result demonstrates that the proposed non-uniform array has a HPBW narrower than a uniform circular array while maintaining a high PSLR.

articleTitle: Design of Microwave Radiating SIW Diplexer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: This paper presents a new design for the integration of microwave SIW diplexer and antenna using multilayer planar technology. The design process started with the network synthesis of the SIW diplexer integrated with patch antenna using lumped lowpass prototype networks. The circular cavity structure using TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">010</sub> mode is employed in the design of the diplexer and TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">110</sub> mode for the antenna. To prove the design concept, modes in the SIW diplexer and in the microstrip antenna are coupled by capacitive circular aperture at the common ground plane. The proposed design is fabricated with standard printed circuit board technology and will be operating at 2.2 GHz and 2.4 GHz each suitable for LTE/WiFi applications. The performance of the proposed design are verified through both simulation and measurement. The measured results showed a good agreement with passband return loss greater than 10 dB in both bands and 20 MHz bandwidth with good radiation pattern and radiation gain measured to be 5.55 dBi and 5.84 dBi.

articleTitle: Multiband UWB Antenna for On-Body Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBAs an emerging technology due to its many possible applications in the society especially in the field of health monitoring. With the increase of communications standards utilizing the Ultra Wide Band (UWB), there tends to be interference on WBAN applications. In this work, a multiband antenna was implemented covering frequencies from 5.9 - 6.6 GHz and 8.45 - 9.25 GHz to minimize the interference caused by known standards. The designed antenna was able to achieve an S11 of less than -10 dB at the operating frequencies. It was also determined that placing a distance of at least 10mm between the designed antenna and human body phantom would substantially remove the degradation caused by the human body. The designed antenna is able to isolate the defined interferences by using multiple bands and allows more efficient usage of the UWB for on-body wireless body area networks.

articleTitle: Amplitude and Phase Controllable Transmissive Coding Metasurface for Arbitrary Wavefront Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: Coding metasurafces have enjoyed an overwhelming development in recent years due to their digital properties in controlling electromagnetic (EM) waves. In this paper, we propose a novel type of amplitude and phase controllable transmissive coding metasurface, in which the patches and slots are integrated together in the unique coding particle, implying to manipulate the amplitude and phase responses independently and simultaneously. We select the coding particles with 1-bit phase states and continual amplitude states to tailor the EM wavefront arbitrarily, such as sinusoidal and sinc-function profiles. The excellent results indicate the strong EM manipulating ability in actual applications.

articleTitle: Dual-Beam Antenna Array using Integrated Butler Feeding Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-beam antenna array using integrated butler feeding network is proposed for radio frequency (RF)-complexity reduction. The proposed antenna array consists of eight identical dipole antenna elements, which are fed with Γ-like structure. The integrated butler feeding network is laid out to form a special phase distribution that can achieve dual-beam in the vertical dimension. Compared with the traditional antenna array, only a quarter of ports are employed to excite all antenna elements in the proposed array, which can reduce RF-complexity enormously. The simulated results show that the main beams at +21° and -21° in E-plane and the gain of 10.4 dBi are achieved at 2.6 GHz.

articleTitle: A K/Ka Multi-Polarized Dielectric Rod Antenna Based on A Wideband Band OMT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation (ISAP)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband multi-polarized dielectric rod antenna is proposed. By employing the orthomode transducer (OMT) feeding structure which is realized by using ridged waveguides, the impedance bandwidth of the antenna is widened effectively and the multi-polarized radiation performance is achieved.
